inference: Restore frozen safe-JSON parameters and fixed thresholds; no fitting, vocabulary updates, rule changes or representation selection. Build headline plus full saved body; commit all predictions before joining reference labels. Use the existing token-chunk and pooling functions unchanged.
metrics: Per-target positive-class precision, recall, F1 and TP/FP/FN/TN, with resolved counts and unresolved targets excluded individually. Average positive-class F1 equally across the three targets. Use the same zero-division convention as development.
sensitivity: Report all articles and, separately, omit the largest reserved related-report component, selected by article count with lexicographic group-ID tie-breaking. Also report each component, source and calendar quarter. These are descriptive sensitivities and never select a replacement primary method.
uncertainty: No independence-based confidence intervals: one of 31 conservative related-report components contains 86 of 120 articles, and only three disruption positives remain outside it.
one_time_policy: Refuse to overwrite a completed evaluation. Validation may reproduce exactly the same frozen predictions and metrics, but cannot change settings, refit on references, reinterpret the original reservation as unexposed, or create another primary-model selection.
financial_scope: Do not load financial outcomes. Preserve the previously fixed 2023 financial validation and 2024-2025 financial test dates. No NLP tuning is permitted from these holdout results.
